name: WIC (food for women, infants and children)
administeredBy: USDA Food and Nutrition Administration, through state agencies
valueBasis: A monthly food package, breastfeeding support and health referrals.

criteria.instructions: Does the household include someone WIC is for? WIC serves people who are pregnant, who gave birth within the last six months, who are breastfeeding a child under one, infants, and children under five.
criteria.askIfUnsure: Is anyone pregnant, recently had a baby, breastfeeding, or is there a child under five?

criteria.postpartum: someone gave birth in the last six months
criteria.breastfeeding: someone is breastfeeding a child under one
criteria.infant: there is an infant under one
criteria.child_under_5: there is a child under five

criteria.instructions: Does the household receive SNAP, Medicaid or TANF? Any one of these makes the household automatically income eligible for WIC.
criteria.askIfUnsure: Does anyone here get SNAP, Medicaid or TANF?
